mapper.sql: id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, COUNT(a.id) as article_count, COALESCE(SUM(a.view_count), 0) as total_views, COALESCE(SUM(a.like_count), 0) as total_likes, MAX(a.create_time) as last_article_time FROM user u LEFT JOIN article a ON u.id = a.author_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname ORDER BY article_count DESC
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.status = 1
